label: D2 after a2 -> S2 (common), when the previous trial was rewarded, in the first ~60 trials of an episode
explanation: Reset-gate unit 5 is active almost only at D2 (98% of activation mass), and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition, and the previous trial was rewarded (no activations at all when prev_reward == 0). It is silent at GO, after a1 and after S1. It also depends strongly on episode time: it is most active in trials 10-49 and goes silent after about trial 60, which no task variable explains (probably a slow drift in the hidden state). Many of its activations coincide with a high value-head output (value > 8.1: rate 28%). Within a run of rewarded a2->S2 trials, magnitude is largest at the first D2 after the reward and shrinks with each repeat (1.0, 0.63, 0.5). The weak activations (lowest quartile) are at D1 after a rewarded a2->S2 trial. Requiring good != 1 or prev_action != 1 raises dev F1 only slightly (0.74 vs 0.71), so the simpler predicate is recorded. All variables are observed at D2. Dev: P 0.62, R 0.83, F1 0.71, mass recall 0.98.
